# Automation To You

Automation To You (ATY) is a Brazilian studio that builds professional websites for small and medium businesses. Sites are designed and reviewed by a developer, with AI used to speed up the work, and come connected to payments (Pix, card), WhatsApp and online scheduling. After the website, ATY also offers AI customer service on WhatsApp, CRMs and business automation.

## Official Website

- https://www.automationtoyou.com.br/

## Services

- Landing pages
- Institutional websites
- Websites with online payments or scheduling
- Custom systems (client areas, CRMs, internal dashboards)
- AI customer service on WhatsApp and business automation
